title: SkillZip: Evaluation-Free Skill Compression for Self-Evolving Agents by Discovering Reusable Structure
abstract: arXiv:2608.11079v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Self-evolving agents accumulate reusable skills by appending successful procedures and failure fixes. Over time, the same requirement is often restated in several branches, examples, and warnings, while common action sequences are copied rather than reused. The resulting skill becomes expensive to inject and difficult to maintain. Generic prompt compression is ill-suited to this setting because a skill is not a flat passage: its name and description define when it applies, its workflow controls execution, its tool and output contracts constrain validity, and rare exceptions may remain essential even when no sampled task activates them. Evaluation-guided compression can test these behaviors, but it introduces rollouts, cost, and dependence on the compression-time evaluation set. We present SkillZip, an evaluation-free method that compresses a skill by finding its shortest faithful structural explanation. The intuition is explain once,

translated_title: SkillZip：通过发现可复用结构实现无评估技能压缩的自进化智能体
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11079v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：自进化智能体通过追加成功程序和失败修复来积累可复用技能。随着时间推移，相同需求往往会在多个分支、示例和警告中重复表述，而常见动作序列被复制而非复用。这导致技能变得昂贵且难以维护。通用提示压缩不适合此场景，因为技能并非扁平文本：其名称和描述定义适用条件，工作流控制执行，工具和输出契约约束有效性，而罕见异常即使在无采样任务激活时也可能至关重要。评估引导压缩可测试这些行为，但会引入回滚、成本和压缩时评估集的依赖。我们提出SkillZip，一种无评估方法，通过寻找最短忠实结构解释来压缩技能。其直觉是“解释一次”。
tldr: SkillZip提出了一种无评估的技能压缩方法，通过发现技能的最短忠实结构解释来降低自进化智能体的技能注入和维护成本，无需回滚或评估集依赖。
en_tdlr: SkillZip proposes an evaluation-free skill compression method that finds the shortest faithful structural explanation, reducing injection and maintenance costs for self-evolving agents without rollouts or evaluation-set dependence.
